entities.name: saddled horse standing behind the loaded cart
entities.what: A horse (or mule) standing on the street just east of the big mat-covered cart's rear, facing west toward the cart with its head held low at the chest of the man standing there; a dark saddle-cloth (or pack-saddle pad) hangs on its side at the withers; its tail hangs at the east end. No rider. Its neck, drawn as a dark straight band with the mane, slopes from the withers (24587, 73) down to the head; it may be tied to or led behind the cart.
entities.vis: part: its head and neck overlap the man at the cart's rear
entities.note: Body u 24540-24635, back line v 75-85, belly v 130; fore legs u 24557-24570 (hooves about (24565, 170)), hind legs u 24607-24620 (hooves about (24615, 166)). Withers about 85-95 px above the hooves. The head is read as the light rounded shape with eye and nostril strokes at u 24486-24520, v 98-120 (est within 10 px); the dark band (24523, 112) -> (24587, 73) could also be a pole or trace joining the horse to the cart's rear. The restyle draws a brown saddled horse facing west and adds riders in red and three standing men below it at v 160-250 (invented: the scan has open ground there). Part of t5's cart group (the cart at u ~24350-24515 is pulled west by two mules at u ~24190-24275 (t5's S2.ani.cart_mule_lead_24192 and S2.ani.cart_mule_near_24215; t5 reads mules: no horns, slim bodies)): the merge should add this horse to t5's group; if t5 also recorded it, drop one.

entities.name: man standing at the horse's head behind the cart
entities.what: A man in a long light robe and a dark cap standing just behind the rear of the big loaded cart, with the horse's lowered head at his chest (holding its bridle?); a carter or groom of the cart team.
entities.vis: part: the cart's rear frame and the horse's neck cross him
entities.note: Robe u 24481-24530, hem at v 169-171 (feet not drawn separately); dark cap u 24501-24519, v 76-91. Painted height about 95 px at foot v 171. ON THE t5 SEAM (foot u 24506): t5 may record him too. Both readings: one man (the light round shape at (24497, 107) is the horse's head), or two men side by side (the restyle draws a blue-capped man at about (24505, 105) and a red-robed one at about (24520, 110)); a second man would stand at u ~24490, t5's side. Facing uncertain.

entities.name: porter carrying a sack on his back
entities.what: Porter in a short jacket and trousers bent forward under a big sack carried across his back and shoulders (its tied neck hangs at his west side), a stick in his right hand trailing behind him; seen from behind, walking north-west up from the boats toward the loaded cart. A grain or goods porter.
entities.vis: part: his head hidden under the sack
entities.note: Feet (24514-24526, 460-467) and (24549-24560, 463-470). Sack u 24501-24559, v 366-391 (top of load v 366). Stick (24554, 423) -> (24583, 433). Painted height to the head about 81 px (bent), to the top of the load 100 px, at foot v 466. He walks behind t5's sack porter at about (24455, 432) (same pose, facing west; a thin line (24476, 392)-(24504, 382) joins them, a stick held by the front porter): the porters' group is t5's.

entities.name: man standing beside the stack of poles
entities.what: A man in a dark knee-length robe with his hair in a top knot, standing on the street at the east side of the stacked poles near the top of the silk, turned toward the porter with baskets coming past him.
entities.note: Body u 24720-24740, head u 24724-24735, v 49-61; a foot dot at (24737, 116). Painted height about 67 px at foot v 116, a little smaller than the basket porter beside him (80 px at v 120): an adult (a youth?) rather than a child. Facing uncertain (east or toward the viewer). The restyle draws him as a boy leaning out beside a willow.

entities.name: porter with two baskets on a shoulder pole
entities.what: Porter in a round brimmed hat, short jacket and trousers walking with a carrying pole over his shoulder: a wide flat basket hangs low on ropes at the west end and a second flat basket higher at the east end. A street porter or vendor.
entities.note: Feet (24784-24791, 120-124) and (24815-24825, 115-119). Pole (24757, 55) -> (24835, 31); west basket u 24756-24789, v 99-111 (nearly at the ground); east basket u 24792-24832, v 71-82. Painted height about 80 px at foot v 120. Direction of walking uncertain (west or east); the west leg is the forward one and the restyle turns his face west.

entities.name: dark-clad figure at the west end of the stall table
entities.what: A figure in dark clothes at the west end of the stall under the scaffolded building's sweeping west eave, at the table with goods (a stall keeper or a customer).
entities.note: Dark mass u 24635-24678, v 430-478, with upright strokes below it at u 24645-24675 to v 492. Painted height only about 58 px at foot v 490 (the porter at v 466 is about 100 px; the two men on the bank at u ~25330-25370 about 115-120 px), so he may be seated or bending. BOTH READINGS: a dark-clad man (the restyle draws a man in blue standing at the table's west end), or a dark low bench or stand with four legs (u 24635-24678) belonging to the stall.

entities.name: figure behind the stall table
entities.what: A dark head and shoulders showing behind the stall table under the eave, as of someone seated or standing behind it (the stall keeper?).
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the table and the goods
entities.note: Dark round head and shoulders u 24695-24718, v 392-418, just above the table top (v 440-460). Foot est behind the table's back edge. Could be goods (a dark jar or bundle) instead of a person; the restyle draws a small head at the table's east end at about (24730, 425) and a light-robed figure leaning over the table at about (24660, 430).

entities.name: stall table under the west eave
entities.what: A long table (or trestle counter) set out under the sweeping west eave of the scaffolded building, with goods on it; legs with a diagonal brace.
entities.note: Top u 24678-24742, v 440-460; legs at u 24702-24718 and about 24735, feet at v 488-492; a diagonal stroke (24683, 460) -> (24705, 492) (a brace or a stick). SCALE: about 64 px long, top about 32-50 px above the feet. Possibly continued west by a dark bench at u 24635-24678 (see S2.fig.stall_keeper_24650).

entities.name: goods piled on the stall table
entities.what: Light rounded bundles or baskets heaped on the west end of the stall table, with sprigs standing up from them (the restyle reads them as branches or flowers in a basket).
entities.note: Light forms u 24655-24693, v 398-440. Could also be a figure in a light robe bending over the table (both readings). Base set on the table top at its west end (v ~445), est.

entities.name: stack of upright poles at the street's top
entities.what: A dense stack of long poles (or bundled stalks) standing upright and leaning together on the street at the top of the silk, just east of the shop behind the cart, its top rounded; timber for the scaffold?
entities.note: Mass of vertical strokes u 24640-24720, v 22-120, top edge arching (24640, 30)-(24700, 35), foot ragged at v 110-120. Base = middle of its foot line. The restyle paints a willow here (invented: no trunk or whips are painted). Could also be a mat-and-pole screen or the end wall of a shed: if structures_w/e record it as part of a building, drop this.

entities.name: tall pole with a hanging signboard
entities.what: A tall thin wooden pole standing at the street-level corner where the scaffolded building meets the hall to the east, rising above the low eave to a knob at its top; a narrow vertical light signboard hangs beside it on the west, above the low eave, with two or three faint characters: □□(□), all illegible.
entities.note: Pole u 25230-25239, v 245-492 (it rises above the low roof's eave at v ~360, so it is not a column of the building). Board u 25183-25208, v 293-360, about 27 px west of the pole: hung from it on an arm (the restyle draws a bracket at v ~265) or fixed to the scaffolded building's low roof (then it is structures_e's: drop it here). Marks on the board at about (25195, 305) and (25196, 330). The restyle draws a board with two or three characters it can't read either.

entities.name: mooring post with a coiled rope on the bank
entities.what: A short stout mooring post on the bank in front of the scaffolded building, with a rope wound round its foot in coils; the rope runs from it down the bank to the boat moored at the bank to the south-east (river_m's).
entities.note: Post u 25200-25213, v 520-548 (knob top at (25207, 522)); rope coils u 25180-25235, v 530-560; the rope's two strands run (25210, 560) -> (25260, 630) -> (25320, 675) to the gunwale of the boat moored at u ~25150-25990 (river_m's). The bank here: building front (wall foot) v ~500, dark wash of the bank slope v 520-600, the shore at about v 600-640. The restyle draws the post and the coiled rope the same.

entities.name: head and shoulders above the scaffolded roof's west end (east)
entities.what: A head in a cap with a pointed, crown-like top and a lighter face below it, with dark shoulders, showing above the scaffolded building's roof just west of the scaffold's first poles; a person behind the roof, or a ridge ornament.
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the roof
entities.note: Cap u 24857-24878, v 237-252; face v 252-265; shoulders to v ~290. Same three readings as head_over_roof_w_24840 (retired at the second pass) (person behind the building, worker on the roof, or ridge ornament). Second pass (middle): a spiky cap over a lighter round face, 27 px east along the ridge from the ridge-end ornament; a head or a ridge beast, undecided (g_ridge.jpg). Kept low.

entities.name: slatted goods racks in the hall's open west corner
entities.what: Two slatted display racks (tiered stands with diagonal slats), set at an angle to each other on the floor in the open west corner of the hall east of the scaffolded building, loaded with many small upright goods (sprigs, bundles or small wares) along their tops.
entities.note: Racks u 25253-25340, v 397-490 (the west one's foot about (25270, 490), the east one's about (25320, 470)); the goods along their tops u 25257-25333, v 397-420. Base = middle of the two feet, est. BOTH READINGS: shop racks of goods (the restyle draws shelves with goods), or a lattice balustrade of the hall with potted plants on it (then it is part of structures_e's building: drop this). Straddles t7's range (25300): its middle reads at about 25290. Merge: t7 recorded the same racks as S2.prop.shop_goods_rack_25325 (conf low; retired as a duplicate, merge crop gen/map/S2/look/merge_rack_25300.jpg): a stepped rack or shelves stacked with lattice-work wares rising from the front at the west (25255, 470) to the back at the east (25340, 390), extents u 25250-25400, v 390-480, with the shopkeeper S2.fig.shopkeeper_25360 behind it; t7's other reading is a stair rising toward a loft (then part of S2.bld.open_shop_25340).

entities.name: the stall under the scaffolded building's west eave
entities.what: A small stall set out under the sweeping west eave of the scaffolded building on the bank: a table heaped with goods, a dark-clad figure at its west end and a head behind it.
entities.note: The eave and the building are structures_e's. Heavily ambiguous at the scan's resolution: see the members' notes.
